Title: New SAP HANA Certified Memory-Optimized Virtual Machines now available

Body.Content:
New SAP HANA Certified Memory-Optimized Virtual Machines now available

In June 2020, we announced general availability of Azure general purpose and memory optimized Virtual Machines based on the 2nd generation Intel Xeon Platinum 8272CL (Cascade Lake) to deliver up to roughly 20 percent CPU performance improvement compared to their predecessors, the Dv3 and Ev3 VM , depending on the workload.

Today, we are expanding our SAP HANA certifications, enabling you to run production SAP HANA workloads on the Edsv4 virtual machines sizes.

Read the announcement blog (URL:Link to blog when published)
